notes.title: Granser
notes.notes:
Loosely following up the story of Skautfold after a few thousand year time skip on a new planet distant from earth, Granser is a new 3 game series in the style of a "jrpg".

The story of Granser will be presented as 3 games serving as the 3 acts of the same story following the same group of characters. Saves will be transferable game to game.

The games will be story focused turn based rpgs in the more Japanese style. 

---[b]The setting and story[/b]
-I have little to reveal about this yet besides the fact it takes place in an entirely new world but still rooted in elements set up in Skautfold. I have spent a considerable part of my lifetime building this setting and Skautfold was built to serve as a prequel to this setting. The story was mainly inspired by Xenogears, Xenosaga and early Tales of games.

---[b]Combat[/b] is a much improved version of the Knight's End combat system, featuring a full party of 4 characters.
-A much improved "Guard System" returning from Usurper, Moonless Knight and Knight's End.
-A refined implementation of timed attack and defence inputs from Knight's End, rewarding good timing and knowledge of the combat triangle.
-A "Burst System" where party wide resource called "Burst Points" are used to unleash a flurry of directional combo inputs used to execute Finishing Strike skills, inspired by the system of Xenogears.
-A fresh take on statuses and their interactions.
-A setup and set-off system for a more engaging interplay of party member's skills.

---[b]Exploration and additional gameplay[/b]
-Aside from the mandatory story content, you will be periodically be let loose to engage with the more free-form content of the world, engaging in hunts, dynamic world map conflict events, and dungeon delving.
-Character and gear progression unique to each of the 4 party members.
-Instead of grinding against weak mobs, you can train and duel your party members to learn new skills and improve synergy among them. 
-Engage in airship to airship combat! Around halfway through the first game you unlock your airship, the sky is not safe however and you will have to engage in ship to ship combat, as well as face flying beasts with it.
-Fishing... in the sky, Sky fishing will be a more relaxing activity to take a break with.


Recently I started learning 3d modelling and animation to accelerate my production of sprites, as well as significantly increase their quality, so expect a noticeable jump in quality and a far more animated, and clear presentation.

Overall the games will each be approximately 25-30 hours long, much larger than any of my previous ones.

The first of the 3 games should arrive on steam early access spring 2023 and develop chapter by chapter till its conclusion.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MuUa7Eq.jpg[/img]

I will share more when I open a new Granser and Skautfold focused DIscord, and maybe I have something fun to sharer about one of my old games soon? Who knows..... :P

notes.title: Knight's End: Final epilogue chapter added.
notes.notes:
-Added final boss.
-Added 3 more combat aid characters.
-1 New achievement


With this, the Skautfold series is fully concluded.
I must apologies for delaying this so long, it was a personal conflict to overcome. 
A most sinciere thanks to everyone who stuck with my series of messy experiments!



Currently working on Usurper 2.0, a wide range of fixes and improvements, as well as rebalances.
But as for the long term future....

"Granser" the sequel series to Skautfold is in production :)
It will be far removed in time from Skautfold taking place in a new setting.

notes.title: 1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
As of now the game is in 1.0
However this is not the end. 
The game will enjoy a few months of active development post launch, as well as the "Final Step" as a free dlc/content update, which will conclude the whole series in a climactic finale, as well as two more summons to collect.

Additionally the game now has its achievements unlocked, and available to collect.


Once the post launch work is completed, I will be moving on to Usurper to touch up the game, a process I plan to do for Into the Fray, and Moonless Knight too, in preparation for the future.

After that, hopefully I will be able to start on Border, the new series that serves as the sequel to Skautfold separated by thousands of years and quite a few light-years.

notes.title: #Patch 1
notes.notes:
Day 1 patches contained the following changes:

-Guard regen outside of combat endabled. Next will be running cost deduction.
-720p, and 900p resolutions and fullscreen on/off added to settings. Next will be full key rebinds.
-Treasure chest added for all weapons/spells instead of generic on ground item icon.
-Overworld enemy alert, and chase system added. For now they work on a simple line of sight, when broken they stop, this is normal for now.
-Darkness and light values inside Manor adjusted for a less "staring into the sun" experience.
